title: The Signature Approach to Carbon Nanotube Processors (Signature)
provenance: Signature original design work by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Signature-labeled original designs and improvements — original work, not presented as established public fact.
description: The Signature approach industrializes carbon: purified feedstock, aligned deposition, imperfection-tolerant design, and a real foundry line. The nanotube computer stops being a demo and becomes a product line. This is Signature original work by Justin Addam Higgins: an original design direction for Carbon Nanotube Processors, labeled as Signature throughout, and never presented as established public fact. Signature CNT processors ship as edge-AI SoCs and space computers: 10x the efficiency of silicon, flexible when needed, radiation-hard when needed. Carbon takes its place beside silicon.

Original work: designed by Justin Addam Higgins, Signature-labeled throughout.
Ladder rank 1 — the Signature foundation for this technology.
